## About
BeStrong Chiropractic is a family chiropractic office in Mansfield, owned and operated by Dr. Stephen Berndt, D.C. Chiropractic is a natural form of health care. We use spinal adjustments to correct misalignments and help your body recover on its own, without drugs or surgery.
Dr. Berndt did his undergrad studies at the University of Northern Iowa, where he was a pre-med major and a walk-on for the UNI Panthers football team. He earned his Doctor of Chiropractic degree at Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa, along with a Bachelor Degree in Biology.
Giving back matters to us. Dr. Berndt and his wife Michelle donate time and chiropractic services to Mansfield and the surrounding communities. Patients have given the office a 5 star rating across 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic spinal adjustments: Precise adjustments to correct misalignments, using Diversified, Gonstead, Thompson, Activator, Flexion-Distraction and extremity techniques.
- Active Release Techniques: Hands-on work offered alongside your adjustments, together with Graston Technique.
- Progressive exercise therapy: Exercise work and foam rolling to build on your care between visits. We also offer Kinesio-Tape, therapeutic ultrasound, muscle and interferential stimulation, moist heat and cryotherapy.

## FAQ
Q: Does chiropractic care involve drugs or surgery?
A: No. Chiropractic uses precise spinal adjustments to correct misalignments so your body can recover on its own.

Q: Where did Dr. Berndt train?
A: He earned his doctorate at Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa, after undergrad studies at the University of Northern Iowa.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I send a message?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 48 to 72 hours.
